The '''giant spider''' is a [[ranged]]-based monster. The level 2 or 4 variant is commonly fought for early combat training. Many can be found in [[Lumbridge Swamp]], and many more in the [[Feldip Hills]]. Low-level players wishing to train on giant spiders should prioritise those found in the swamps.

Giant spiders are weak to crush attacks, but any melee weapon should suffice.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Melee ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Ranged ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Magic ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Tiny plated bronze salvage → Bronze med helm
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield
** Giant spiders in [[Lumbridge Swamp]] have been updated in combat prowess:
*** Adjusted their combat level to 4 (from 2)
*** Increased HP to 1000 (from 550)
*** Reduced their max hit to 40 (from 60)
*** Defence level reduced slightly

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament &amp; Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (18 March 2013)|date=18 March 2013}}
** [[Grotworm]]s, [[moss giant]]s, [[banshee]]s, [[jungle spider]]s, [[shadow spider]]s, [[spider]]s, giant spiders, [[deadly red spider]]s, [[ice spider]]s, [[scorpion]]s, [[poison scorpion]]s and [[pit scorpion]] will no longer hit for 1 hit point worth of damage.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (24 November 2010)|date=24 November 2010}}
** Giant spiders will no longer sink into the ground when dying.

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=Patch Notes (12 October 2010)|date=12 October 2010}}
** The examine text of giant spiders outside of the [[Stronghold of Security]] have has their examines changed to say "magically modified" instead of "genetically modified".

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}
